{{Top|leg}}
The '''Bl'Era Har''' ('''Sky-Track''') was an early warning system used by the [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothites]] to detect orbital threats. It was run on a limited budget. The Bl'Era Har was the first to spot the incoming [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] that would led to the [[Se'Lenti|devastation]] of [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]].
